WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  risk_margin_count,
  1.0 * risk_margin_count / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
  1.0 * risk_margin_count / AVG(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM scope_counts;
